prompt: Long lens at eye level down a straight Victorian terraced street on a hill in a northern English town: a queue of adults on the pavement runs the length of the street, over the brow of the hill and on to the horizon, people holding plastic bags and flasks, some sitting on the kerb, a church hall door lit at the very front. Breath steaming. Winter dusk in a near-future Britain, cold blue-grey light, the only warm colour the small orange fires of braziers and camping stoves; photographed like a feature film on 35mm stock: fine grain, deep shadows that stay dark, no lens flare, no bloom, no teal-orange grade. 16:9. No writing anywhere in the frame: no signs, banners, logos, number plates or screen text. No children.
